notes: Speed: average running speed incl. accel/braking, tram 8 m/s (~29 km/h), sky rail 12 m/s (~43 km/h). Run sec = chainage gap / speed, rounded. Starting values [S], tune by playtest.
Headways [S]: T1 150 s, T2 180 s, S1 120 s. Dwell [S]: tram 20 s, sky rail 25 s.
Journey sec = in-vehicle ride time only, plus dwell at each intermediate stop. Total price of boarding = wait + ride; expected wait is half the headway (max one full headway).
Cross-line journeys count ride on each line only; the wait for the second service and the walk between stops are added separately.
Interchange walk: sky station to tram stop at Crown Circus is about 120 m per the plan; no walking time is set here.
Both directions assumed symmetric; reverse journeys have the same ride time. Lines are double-track so no single-track conflicts.
T1 and T2 beyond-sheet extents (Southside, north/south-west termini) are not timetabled; S1 loop at Skyport and T1 circus balloon loop not in stop list, so turnaround time is not priced.
Phase offsets between lines are not specified; waits assume independent arrival.

openQuestions.question: Does boarding cost anything beyond wait + ride (fare, cooldown, noise, Trail)?
openQuestions.why: GDD §02 says time only; I have priced nothing else.

openQuestions.question: Is the wait a fixed schedule the player can read, or a random draw within the headway?
openQuestions.why: Determines whether travel time is predictable for planning; I assumed a fixed timetable.

openQuestions.question: Should the T1 balloon loop and the S1 Skyport loop turnaround time be part of the journey price, and can the cell board at a loop terminus?
openQuestions.why: The stop lists do not include loop time.

openQuestions.question: Do the tram T1 extension to Crown Road and the retirement of the Sphere loop and harbour line stand (Datum's plan questions)?
openQuestions.why: A different network would change the timetable.
